text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the academy, I didn't<n>think I'd be
able to grow any<n>veggies! Am I glad we have a
garden<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the veggies grow bigger an'<n>bigger with
each day, losin' track of<n>time fidget'n with the
dirt—there's<n>nothin' quite as relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why don't you join me<n>next time,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Agri-healing—that's what they're<n>call'n it! I bet it'd
do a city boy like<n>you some good!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Agri-healing—that's what they're<n>call'n it! I bet it'd
do a city girl like<n>you some good!
